question: Which deity is prescribed with crop-dark human form, right-hand pointing-finger mudra, left hand at waist, emblem-marked head, and all ornaments?
inference: The verse prescribes Musali's iconographic form.
plain_english: Musali is crop-dark and human-formed, has right-hand pointing-finger mudra, left hand at waist, emblem-marked head, and all ornaments.
